Name: Snap Catch
Author: ByVaikonC4
Description:
Snap Catch
Replaces the fishing bobber-bar minigame with a single, quick timing check - styled after the vanilla bar, so it still feels like fishing, just faster.
[heading]How it works[/heading]
When a fish bites, instead of the full bobber-bar minigame you get a short vertical bar with four nested color bands:
[list]
[*][b]Green[/b] - Normal quality[/*]
[*][b]Yellow[/b] - Silver quality[/*]
[*][b]Red[/b] - Gold quality[/*]
[*][b]Purple[/b] - Iridium quality (a "perfect" catch)[/*]
[/list]A marker bounces up and down the bar. Press your tool-use button (click / controller A or X) once, at the right moment, to hook the fish. Where the marker lands decides the quality - land outside every band and the fish gets away, same as missing the vanilla minigame.
If a treasure chest is rolled for that catch, landing the fish is followed by one more independent press at a separate orange hit-box, placed so it never overlaps the fish's own zone.
[heading]What scales the difficulty[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Fish difficulty[/b] - harder fish shrink the catch zone and speed up the marker.[/*]
[*][b]Fishing skill[/b] - a higher Fishing level widens the zone and slows the marker a little.[/*]
[*][b]Rod tier[/b] - better rods widen the zone.[/*]
[*][b]Tackle[/b] - Quality Bobbers widen the zone and bump the final catch quality.[/*]
[/list]All of this reuses the game's own vanilla formulas for fish size, treasure rolls and bait bonuses - only the actual minigame is replaced, not the underlying catch balance.
[heading]Configuration[/heading]
Every number above (zone sizes, band proportions, marker speed, treasure hit-box size) is configurable. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed, you can tune everything from an in-game menu - no manual 
[code]config.json[/code] editing needed.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[/list][heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Do not use alongside other mods that also skip or replace the fishing minigame (e.g. SkipFishingMinigame) - both will try to hook the same code and only one will actually take effect, leaving the other dormant.
[heading]Credits[/heading]
Built with Pathoschild's mod package and [url=https://github.com/pardeike/Harmony]Harmony[/url] (bundled with SMAPI).
